Objectif: tester si l'ecart entre simulation et stock composants immobilise reel peut venir du fait que la simulation sert 100% de la demande, alors que les taux reels indiques sont:
historical_93_80.conclusion: This derived experiment states historical declared rates 93%/80% but gives no industrial dataset, period, numerator or denominator. The inspected source demand/finance/stock files do not provide those exact operational rates; do not substitute the annual financial shares 92.87%/95.40% for them.

interpretation_and_precedence.decision: Preserve without changes. demand_PF zero-negative and financial estimated delivered quantities remain the explicit accepted comparison scenario, not a new independent measurement of client physical deliveries.

Use detailed Stocks rows keyed article/site/date from Flow Inventory and Replenishment for physical stock comparisons. Keep quantity and unit as source values; do not replace them with monetary stock CSV divided by an inferred price.

Flow Customer Historique is explicitly dated and more granular in calendar metadata than demand_PF; keep the literal Actual Demand role while showing contradictions with CA and net movements. More recent filename/file modification is not proof that it supersedes demand_PF business scope.

Flow Customer Projection has 13 true source vintages per PF, each 52 weeks, reaching 2026-12-28. Use only the vintage known as of the simulated decision date. demand_PF forecast equals its own actual column and is redundant, not an independent forecast.

Use signed CA_Livre/CA_Perdu per product/date. Preserve negative adjustment. Financial share=sum(delivered)/sum(delivered+lost) on exactly the same period, not an average daily rate or physical OTIF. A price and scope are required to infer units; demand*financialshare remains conditional.
Retain Divers/Entrees/Sorties/scan3 as signed fields. For PF1920 this table supports net stock changes but cannot be used alone as gross factory receipts or customer dispatches.

Keep as separate financial observations until perimeter/valuation basis reconciled. They are not exact redundant copies of the Stocks workbook and cannot be deleted as obsolete or reinterpreted as physical factory stock.
Dispo_PF_Projete.csv is snapshots of projected shortage counts in 2025 and 2026, not observed realized daily service. Do not sum overlapping snapshots or use them to validate 2025 realized shipments.

findings.finding: The 104 demand_PF forecast cells equal real-demand cells exactly. This workbook does not supply an independent forecast for those rows.

The current Customer Demand workbook removes SKU Label columns only relative to 8ac4831d4; all 106 history and 1352 projection values/dates are unchanged. This structural update does not add new demand observations.

Four negative demand_PF Permixon weeks become zero under the accepted scenario but all have positive delivered revenue; three Flow historical zero weeks also have positive delivered revenue. This prevents declaring either zero-demand series equal to a complete dated shipment journal.

PF movements at Muret have 0 Entrees and 0 scan3 everywhere but positive as well as negative Sorties; the latter cannot uniformly mean gross client departures. Net-stock identity closes on 39/52 Cicalfate and 47/52 Permixon intervals including the initial partial week.

If Actual Demand represents outbound deliveries, stock conservation gives nonnegative inferred receipts for 50/51 full weeks for each PF and 20 exactly zero receipt weeks for Permixon. This is corroboration, not proof; each PF has a negative reconstructed week, and CA conflicts remain.

None of 104 PF stock monetary CSV values equals same-date Stocks workbook valuation at cent precision. Accounting rates and/or scopes differ; valuation cannot supply factory stock without an independent unit valuation and site perimeter.

Source forecasts extend into 2026 while dated historic demand and actual CA stay in 2025. Projected-shortage CSV separately includes 20 snapshot versions in 2026 per PF; those are projections, not realized 2026 delivery history.

Historical 93%/80% references come from a derived stock-allocation experiment, not a source operational-service measurement with specified definition. Financial source ratios are different indicators.
